# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, multilingual online encyclopedia built through collaborative editing, operated by the nonprofit Wikimedia Foundation and powered by MediaWiki software.

Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, Wikipedia has grown into the world's largest crowdsourced knowledge repository with editions in hundreds of languages. The English Wikipedia is the largest edition, featuring millions of articles maintained by volunteer editors following strict editorial standards and content policies.

## Core Information

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia homepage with featured articles and daily content
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Main article about Wikipedia, founded by Jimmy Wales & Larry Sanger
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): Overview of Wikipedia's mission and Wikimedia Foundation operations
- [English Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Article about English Wikipedia edition and its history
- [History of Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Historical development from Nupedia to modern Wikipedia
- [Wikipedia:Contents - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Site directory and navigation hub for browsing Wikipedia topics

## Policies and Guidelines

- [Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:What_Wikipedia_is_not): Policy defining Wikipedia's scope and content guidelines
- [Wikipedia:Researching with Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Researching_with_Wikipedia): Guide on using Wikipedia for academic research and reliability
- [Wikipedia:Formal organization - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Formal_organization): Essay on Wikipedia's administrative structure and user roles

## Reference and Resources

- [Wikipedia:Glossary - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Glossary): Dictionary of Wikipedia terminology, abbreviations, and jargon
- [Wikipedia:Featured articles - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_articles): Collection of highest quality articles meeting editorial standards
- [List of Wikipedias - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias): Comprehensive list of Wikipedia language editions and statistics
- [Wiki - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki): Explanation of wiki concept, MediaWiki, and collaborative editing
- [Encyclopedia - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Encyclopedia): Article defining encyclopedias and knowledge compilation methods

## Help and Support

- [Help:Language - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Language): Language help guide for multilingual Wikipedia navigation
- [Wikipedia:The Wikipedia Library - Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:The_Wikipedia_Library): Research hub providing editors access to paywalled sources
